author: Good Enough
description:
A sandstorm can turn dangerous in seconds, reducing visibility to almost nothing and filling the air with dust that can make it difficult to breathe. Knowing how to protect your eyes and lungs, where to take shelter, and what to do if you’re caught outside can make a major difference.

This Short explains how to survive a sandstorm, what to do during a dust storm, how to protect yourself from blowing sand, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during extreme weather.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Sandstorm 🌪️⚠️ #naturaldisaster #sandstorm #survival #outdoors
